mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_message m LEFT JOIN sys_message_receiver r ON r.message_id = m.id AND r.receiver_type = #{receiverType} AND r.receiver_id = #{userId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 AND m.receiver_type = #{receiverType} AND m.channel = 'IN_APP' AND m.publish_time <= NOW() AND (r.id IS NULL OR r.read_status = 0)
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO sys_message_receiver ( id, message_id, receiver_type, receiver_id, read_status, read_time, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, is_deleted ) VALUES
( #{state.id}, #{state.messageId}, #{state.receiverType}, #{state.receiverId}, #{state.readStatus}, #{state.readTime}, NOW(), #{state.receiverId}, NULL, NULL, 0 )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE read_time = CASE WHEN sys_message_receiver.read_status = 2 AND VALUES(read_status) = 1 THEN sys_message_receiver.read_time WHEN VALUES(read_status) = 1 THEN COALESCE(sys_message_receiver.read_time, VALUES(read_time)) ELSE NULL END, read_status = CASE WHEN sys_message_receiver.read_status = 2 AND VALUES(read_status) = 1 THEN sys_message_receiver.read_status ELSE VALUES(read_status) END, update_time = CASE WHEN sys_message_receiver.read_status = 2 AND VALUES(read_status) = 1 THEN sys_message_receiver.update_time ELSE NOW() END, update_by = CASE WHEN sys_message_receiver.read_status = 2 AND VALUES(read_status) = 1 THEN sys_message_receiver.update_by ELSE VALUES(receiver_id) END
